content: {"like":["Prefers family‑friendly horror with gentle vampires (Let Me In).","Enjoys fast‑paced, concise action dramas (Blood Father).","Values stylish, smart sci‑fi thrillers (Daybreakers).","Likes films with strong, realistic performances (Jamie Bell, Mel Gibson).","Appreciates hopeful, underdog sports dramas (McFarland, USA)."],"dislike":["Dislikes over‑the‑top gore in horror (Into the Grizzly Maze).","Avoids predictable, weak‑special‑effects horror (Let Me In).","Rejects TV‑movie quality action thrillers (Dogman).","Dislikes melodramatic, sentimental scenes in romantic dramas (Lucky One, The).","Favors realistic, non‑provocative violence over graphic gore (Dogman)."]}
